id: reading-g3-wright-brothers-first-flight

title.en: The Wright brothers and the first aeroplane flight
title.id: Wright bersaudara dan penerbangan pesawat pertama

en: A long time ago, people dreamed of flying like birds. Many tried, but no one had flown a machine with an engine that a pilot could steer. Two brothers from the United States, Wilbur and Orville Wright, decided to try.

Wilbur was born in 1867 and Orville in 1871. They grew up in Dayton, Ohio. As young men, they opened a bicycle shop, where they built and repaired bicycles. This work taught them a lot about light, strong machines and balance.

The brothers watched birds closely. They noticed that birds twist the tips of their wings to stay balanced and turn. They found a way to make an aeroplane's wings twist a little too, so a pilot could control it.

First they built gliders, which fly without an engine. They tested them at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, a windy place with soft sand to land on. Many tests went wrong, so they built a small wind tunnel in their shop to test the shapes of hundreds of model wings.

Next they needed an engine that was strong but light. No company could make one that suited them, so they built their own with the help of their mechanic, Charlie Taylor. They also carved their own propellers.

On 17 December 1903, at Kitty Hawk, Orville lay on the lower wing of their Flyer and started the engine. The aeroplane rose into the air and flew for 12 seconds, about 37 metres. It was the first powered, controlled aeroplane flight.

The brothers took turns and flew four times that day. On the last flight, Wilbur stayed in the air for 59 seconds. Their careful watching, testing and fixing changed the world: today, aeroplanes carry people between the islands of Indonesia every day.
id: Dahulu kala, orang bermimpi bisa terbang seperti burung. Banyak yang mencoba, tetapi belum ada yang berhasil menerbangkan mesin bermotor yang bisa dikendalikan pilot. Dua kakak beradik dari Amerika Serikat, Wilbur dan Orville Wright, memutuskan untuk mencoba.

Wilbur lahir pada tahun 1867 dan Orville pada tahun 1871. Mereka tumbuh di Dayton, Ohio. Ketika dewasa, mereka membuka toko sepeda, tempat mereka membuat dan memperbaiki sepeda. Pekerjaan itu mengajari mereka banyak hal tentang mesin yang ringan dan kuat, serta tentang keseimbangan.

Kakak beradik itu mengamati burung dengan teliti. Mereka melihat bahwa burung memuntir ujung sayapnya untuk menjaga keseimbangan dan berbelok. Mereka menemukan cara agar sayap pesawat juga bisa sedikit dipuntir, sehingga pilot dapat mengendalikannya.

Mula-mula mereka membuat pesawat layang, yang terbang tanpa mesin. Mereka mengujinya di Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, tempat berangin dengan pasir lembut untuk mendarat. Banyak uji coba gagal, jadi mereka membuat terowongan angin kecil di bengkel mereka untuk menguji bentuk ratusan model sayap.

Berikutnya mereka memerlukan mesin yang kuat tetapi ringan. Tidak ada perusahaan yang bisa membuat mesin yang cocok, jadi mereka membuatnya sendiri dengan bantuan montir mereka, Charlie Taylor. Mereka juga memahat baling-baling sendiri.

Pada 17 Desember 1903, di Kitty Hawk, Orville berbaring di sayap bawah pesawat Flyer mereka dan menyalakan mesin. Pesawat itu naik ke udara dan terbang selama 12 detik, sejauh sekitar 37 meter. Itulah penerbangan pesawat bermotor pertama yang bisa dikendalikan.

Kakak beradik itu bergantian dan terbang empat kali hari itu. Pada penerbangan terakhir, Wilbur bertahan di udara selama 59 detik. Pengamatan, pengujian, dan perbaikan mereka yang cermat mengubah dunia: kini pesawat membawa orang antarpulau di Indonesia setiap hari.

offlineActivity.en: Make a paper glider by folding a sheet of paper into a dart. Fly it five times and measure each flight with footsteps. Then change one thing only, such as folding the back edges of the wings up a little, fly it five more times and compare. Write what you changed and what happened, like the Wright brothers did. Fly it in an open space, never towards anyone's face.
offlineActivity.id: Buat pesawat kertas dengan melipat selembar kertas menjadi bentuk anak panah. Terbangkan lima kali dan ukur setiap terbangnya dengan langkah kaki. Lalu ubah satu hal saja, misalnya menekuk sedikit ujung belakang sayap ke atas, terbangkan lima kali lagi dan bandingkan. Tulis apa yang kamu ubah dan apa yang terjadi, seperti yang dilakukan Wright bersaudara. Terbangkan di tempat terbuka, jangan ke arah wajah orang.

factChecks.claim: Wilbur Wright was born in 1867 and Orville Wright in 1871; they lived in Dayton, Ohio, and ran a bicycle business.
The Wrights controlled their aircraft by wing warping, an idea inspired by watching birds.
They tested gliders at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, and built a wind tunnel to test wing shapes.
Their engine was built in their shop with mechanic Charlie Taylor.
On 17 December 1903 Orville flew the Flyer for 12 seconds, about 37 metres (120 feet), the first powered, controlled aeroplane flight.
Four flights were made that day; the longest, by Wilbur, lasted 59 seconds.

safetyNotes.en: Fly paper gliders in an open space and never aim them at faces or eyes.
safetyNotes.id: Terbangkan pesawat kertas di tempat terbuka dan jangan pernah mengarahkannya ke wajah atau mata.
